findings.problem: Said the leaf is heated soon after picking. The Green Tea card says that is commonly true of Japanese leaf only: Chinese leaf is often withered first.
findings.change: "heated soon after picking" became "heated early", the wording of the lesson "Oxidation is the axis" (green is killed early).
